claim: Mixed-cut retargeting is exact for a valid anchor.
assumptions: Finite bags, complete named epochs, fixed target; supported domain.
boundary: The cut sets alone do not establish anchor validity.

claim: A derived-view anchor residual survives exact delta application.
assumptions: Correct retained bases; additive residual in derived components.
boundary: Base corruption can propagate into join/group residuals; the abstract fixed-additive lemma is broader than this executable control.

claim: Structural target admission is exact on the common supported domain.
assumptions: Nonnegative canonical target; symmetric signed-64 coordinates; prefix absolute sums and product at most M.
boundary: It scans the candidate and retains peak base/aggregation state; not universal constant-space verification.

claim: Factorized expected join evaluation enumerates no expected join tuples.
assumptions: Fixed equijoin with canonical five-relation candidate.
boundary: Candidate join is scanned; exact-map indexes, frozen candidates and peak grouping state are charged separately. Production tags are recomputed without a payload cache.

claim: Ideal fixed-candidate error is at most (3/q)^r with exact supported-domain completeness.
assumptions: Prime FIELD=2^127-1; candidate committed before fresh independent uniform tags; no coefficient wrap.
executable_check: small-field algebra, domain and relation-tag controls
boundary: Concrete SHA-256/SHAKE derivation requires computational assumptions; distinct seed bytes alone do not prove independent randomness.

claim: The two-round bound is exactly bounded by 9/(2^127-1)^2, which is less than 2^-250.
assumptions: Ideal per-round bound and independent rounds.
boundary: 9/2^254 is not an upper bound; composite moduli are rejected in production.

claim: Known tags permit nonzero two-term collisions in the algebraic control.
assumptions: Fixed low-level tag binding; adjustable two-term residual.
boundary: 32/32 controls are not a break of the complete commitment-bound Store interface.

claim: A synopsis-free checker must read a sensitive cell with probability at least 1-epsilon.
assumptions: Addressable-cell model, perfect completeness, valid one-cell modification, no dependent trusted synopsis.
executable_check: proof argument; mutation controls illustrate sensitive cells
boundary: A model-specific read lower bound, not a universal database-verification lower bound.

claim: Store publication and service enforce the same complete candidate and authority binding.
assumptions: Trusted Store configuration/decision state; immutable logical objects; atomic root; accepted empty bootstrap.
boundary: Semantic correctness remains conditional on the checker; randomized acceptance is not zero-error proof.

claim: Fallback requires a new commitment, a distinct canonical seed and a fresh admission decision.
assumptions: Independent trusted seed source; canonical bytes/hex decoding.
executable_check: fallback interruption controls and equivalent-seed rejection
boundary: Fallback shares the producer implementation; it is not an independently coded replay implementation.

claim: The storage sweep contains 46800 schedules: 28080 fallback and 18720 direct.
assumptions: 5 target prefixes, 720 flush permutations, 13 crash cuts; identical equation calls may be memoized.
executable_check: publication_rows; cached/uncached small paired tests; verify_results.py
boundary: Every logical transition is executed; repeated equation arithmetic is reused. Not every schedule is poisoned or a fallback.

claim: Both structural and factorized modes reject 57645 one-component mutations each.
assumptions: 11529 endpoints times five components per mode.
executable_check: Two mode-specific mutation counts checked independently
boundary: No unseen generator split or production workload generalization is claimed.

claim: An intact old root is not serviceable for a different requested target.
assumptions: Trusted requested h; old marker differs.
boundary: Old-generation completeness and new-target availability are different invariants.

claim: Receipt-only marking cannot establish exactly-once external effects.
assumptions: Separate effect and receipt writes, lost acknowledgements permitted.
boundary: 72 failures describe this finite control, not a deployed failure rate.

claim: Space accounting includes resident inputs, complete frozen images and historical aggregate keys; the production tag-cache size is zero.
assumptions: Current Python representation, bounded retained attempts, finite logical Store and supplied synthetic cases.
argument: Cost discussion in main paper and proofs/arguments.md C/D
executable_check: Fixed-key increasing-payload, Cartesian join and cancellation controls
boundary: Retained Python object counts are not RSS or physical database benchmarks.

claim: The current deterministic evidence is reproducible by one standard-library command.
assumptions: Python3 with sqlite3, fresh output directory, one worker.
boundary: Correctness fields must match; CPU time, RSS and allocation diagnostics need not match.
